sources.observation: The tower shaft has paired panels of lozenge relief around a central sequence of windows. It supports the full-width open bell stage, narrower lanterns and the Giraldillo.
Stone parapets and slender Gothic pinnacles divide flat terraces and chapel domes. The lanterns and domes rise from separate roof levels.
Stepped Gothic archivolts and slender jambs frame the center of the west portal.

limitations: The tower’s horizontal tier widths follow mapped parts. Published height sets the Giraldillo’s tip; the intermediate stage elevations and relief are approximately reconstructed. The cathedral’s mapped roof levels are interpreted from the available photography.
